item.text:
The report now contains nine reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F9: single-voter reconfiguration with a changed leader address can throw during designated-leader selection**. [Leader.getDesignatedLeader](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/Leader.java:916) removes the current leader from the candidate set, then calls `candidates.iterator().next()` without checking for an empty set. In the repro, the new view has only the current leader with a different address and only its own reconfig ack, producing:

```
java.util.NoSuchElementException
  at org.apache.zookeeper.server.quorum.Leader.getDesignatedLeader(Leader.java:931)
AssertionError: getDesignatedLeader threw instead of returning a valid leader
```

The reproduction is [DesignatedLeaderEmptyRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/designated_leader_empty/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/DesignatedLeaderEmptyRepro.java). It must run through isolated execution because the `Leader` constructor binds a local socket.

The eight prior findings remain documented: rejected-snapshot state leakage, zero snapshot-size division, non-terminating oracle revalidation, 3+ voter oracle election bypass, digest/lastZxid snapshot incompatibility, data retention on `TRUNC(0)`, runtime-exception fallback failure, and empty-tail zxid overstatement. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
